title: Module 4 — City, transport, housing, shopping and services
description: Find your way around a city, talk about transport and housing, and shop for clothes and everyday services, using more irregular verbs, comparatives and the prepositions of movement.

topics.title: In the city and giving directions
topics.brief: Orienting yourself in a city and asking for/giving directions (Onde fica…?, Vá em frente, Vire à direita/esquerda, Siga direto, É perto/longe); places in a city (praça, esquina, semáforo).
topics.known: Module 1 and 2 grammar; m2-spatial-prepositions. Fixed polite chunks (usable as whole phrases, no imperative grammar): Vá…, Vire…, Siga…
topics.avoid: past tenses, comparatives, imperative for strangers beyond polite forms.

topics.title: Transport
topics.brief: Means of transport (de carro, de avião, de comboio, de metro, de autocarro, a pé) and transport prepositions; buying a ticket, asking about schedules and platforms.

topics.title: More irregular verbs and necessity
topics.brief: Presente do Indicativo of vir, poder, querer, dizer, saber; the progressive estar a + infinitivo in context; necessity and obligation with ter de / precisar de + infinitivo.

topics.title: Housing
topics.brief: Describing a house: rooms (sala, quarto, cozinha, casa de banho), furniture and appliances (cama, sofá, frigorífico, máquina de lavar); reading a short rental ad (apartamento, T2, mobilado).
topics.avoid: past tenses, comparatives (introduced next in this module).

topics.title: Shopping, money and services
topics.brief: Clothes and shoes vocabulary, sizes and colors; money, prices and simple banking phrases; the post office; numbers up to 1000 and simple percentages (cinquenta por cento).

topics.title: Comparatives and prepositions of movement
topics.brief: Comparatives (mais … do que, menos … do que, melhor, pior, maior, menor); prepositions of movement a, para, por; personal pronouns with com (comigo, contigo, connosco, convosco); contractions pelo/pela and num/numa.
